The four files list the sphere centres (nm) of model opal crystallites made from four different polystyrene sphere batches (files named by sample; each built from that sample's published sphere diameter; neighbouring spheres touch). Model the film as this lattice with its close-packed planes parallel to the film surface. The spheres have refractive index 1.59 and the voids are filled with a medium of refractive index 1.00; take the effective index from the volume-weighted average of the squared refractive indices (n_eff² = Σ f_i n_i²), using the sphere volume fraction of this packing. You must choose one sample for a new film such that its first-order normal-incidence Bragg reflection from the close-packed planes is closest to 820 nm. Which sample should you choose?

选项：
A. S3 (opal-PS-S3.xyz)
B. S4 (opal-PS-S4.xyz)
C. S2 (opal-PS-S2.xyz)
D. S5 (opal-PS-S5.xyz)

附件：opal-PS-S2.xyz、opal-PS-S3.xyz、opal-PS-S4.xyz、opal-PS-S5.xyz（均为本题完整输入）。范围：按论文 FESEM 球径构建的理想接触球 FCC 晶粒模型（177 个球心，确定性旋转）；不含尺寸分布与堆垛缺陷，不是实测球心坐标。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
